answer: An agent economy can blunt Sybil attacks with staked identity plus quadratic voting. Each agent locks real collateral before its voice counts, and voting weight grows only as the square root of that stake, so one honest deposit outweighs a voyage of many fake wallets. Peers audit the bonds on a public ledger, and a detected impostor is slashed and tagged with an umber mark of fraud. The horizon for an attacker is bleak: matching a hundred genuine agents needs ten thousandfold collateral, and any slip forfeits it all, so the raid never pays.
